projects.title: Swiggy Sales & Customer Behavior Analysis
projects.subtitle: Order, revenue and regional demand dashboard
projects.problem: Understand revenue, demand trends and regional performance across ~197K orders (Rs. 53M+).
projects.approach: Cleaned and modelled data with Power Query and Pivot Tables, then built city/state dashboards with dynamic slicers benchmarking Average Order Value (Rs. 268).
projects.impact: Identified a 33% Q3 demand decline despite stable ratings, flagging a key business risk, and supported Tier-2 expansion strategy.
highlights: Bengaluru is the top city by sales (Rs. 5.46M)
projects.imageAlt: Swiggy sales dashboard built in Excel showing total sales of Rs. 53.01M, 197.43K orders, an average order value of Rs. 268.51, monthly and daily sales trends, sales by state and the top five cities by sales

projects.title: Hospital Emergency Room Operations Analysis
projects.subtitle: ER wait time, satisfaction and load dashboard
projects.problem: Understand how wait times, patient demographics and referrals affect satisfaction across 9,216 ER visits.
projects.approach: Built an Excel operations dashboard and ran demographic and departmental referral analysis.
projects.impact: Linked a 35.26 min average wait to satisfaction trends and efficiency gaps, and found high-load segments (age 60-69, General Practice/Orthopedics) to inform triage and staffing.
highlights: Age group 60-69 identified as highest load
General Practice and Orthopedics identified as high-load departments
projects.imageAlt: Hospital emergency room dashboard built in Excel showing 9,216 patients, a 35.26 minute average wait time, a patient satisfaction score of 4.99, patients by gender, age group and department referral, with year and month selectors
